description: Na₅Al₃H₁₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mnc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent H atoms. All Na-H bond lengths are 2.47 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six H atoms to form distorted NaH₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaH₆ octahedra, corners with six AlH₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NaH₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-71°. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.52 Å. There are two inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to six H atoms to form AlH₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent AlH₆ octahedra and corners with eight equivalent NaH₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-71°. There are four shorter (1.73 Å) and two longer (1.74 Å) Al-H bond lengths. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to six H atoms to form AlH₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlH₆ octahedra and corners with eight equivalent NaH₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-69°. There are four shorter (1.72 Å) and two longer (1.76 Å) Al-H bond lengths. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na and one Al atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Al atoms. In the third H site, H is bonded to three Na and one Al atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing HNa₃Al trigonal pyramids.
